info.title: AlphaHub Go API
info.description: Current Go routes and DTOs. Money is integer kopecks, rates are bps. Bearer JWT expires after 2h. CLIENT routes enforce ownership. Errors may be plain text; DS errors preserve a JSON envelope. data_version prevents lost updates. DS scoring contract remains unchanged.

post.description: Existing INN is linked without overwriting its registry data. User must not already have a company.

get.summary: Company in local registry by INN
get.description: Local database lookup; no live EGRUL connection.

post.description: Synchronous DS call. Score <40 => REJECTED; 40..69 => MANUAL; >=70 => OFFERED. Invalid/incomplete data returns 422. DS failure does not become a credit rejection. No body required.
Identical committed response is idempotent. DECLINE => OFFER_DECLINED; no automatic improved offer.
Re-scores with original submitted_at and frozen annual_rate_bps; returns to MANUAL.
Multipart form field file. Financial statement extraction replaces current financials and invalidates confirmation; re-read application and financials afterward.

put.description: Nonnegative integer kopecks; debt must be present, including explicit 0. Replaces all six records and invalidates confirmation.

post.description: JSON body with current data_version is mandatory; empty body returns 400.
Claim first. Moves MANUAL -> NEEDS_INFO. Only one OPEN request is allowed.

Error.description: 400 invalid JSON/input; 401 no/expired token; 403 wrong role/company; 404 missing/not-owned resource; 409 stale version/workflow/assignment conflict; 413 PDF too large; 422 invalid financial period/product conditions/DS validation; 500 internal; 502 invalid/failed DS response; 503 DS unavailable. Exact applicability varies by operation.
